name: ifq-app-builder
description: IFQ App Builder — an agent-native skill that turns three sentences into a verified build-ready prompt bundle for PC, macOS, Windows, iOS, Android, HarmonyOS, WeChat MiniProgram, self-hosted local web, PWA, or CLI. The core loop is ZERO-install: route mode → fork template → fill three-sentence intent → verify. Platform SDKs are only required by the coding agent that executes the bundle and remain optional.
author: ifq.ai

scripts.validate: npm run smoke && npm run validate:templates

systemRequirements.note: The core loop (generate + verify a prompt bundle) requires ZERO system installs beyond Node. Platform SDKs are only needed when the calling coding agent actually builds the app the bundle describes.
